text:
morgan: getting a pile of GPU node provision failures in eu-central-1 starting 03:07 UTC. warm-pool can't finish bootstrap because keystore decrypts timeout. likely egress block somewhere.

morgan: short log snippet:

morgan: ```
warmup-agent | time=\"2025-06-10T03:08:12Z\" level=error msg=\"decrypt failed\" err=\"rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded\"
warmup-agent | time=\"2025-06-10T03:08:12Z\" level=warn msg=\"retrying decrypt (attempt 5)\"
keystore-proxy | 2025-06-10T03:07:59Z error: dial tcp 10.11.198.23:443: connect: connection refused
keystore-proxy | 2025-06-10T03:08:05Z keystore: request id=abcd-1234 prefetch=128
```

alex: checking control plane logs. I see an IaC change rolled 03:00 UTC to tighten nat-gw egress SG in eu-central-prod by infra/security group id sg-0f3b9. @nina any known firewall rollout?

nina: we did a small lockdown to default-deny egress to prepare for compliance audit. change was supposed to keep VPC endpoints allowed but looks like KMS endpoint subnet was missed. rolling back now.

infrabot: ALERT: warm-pool eu-central warm nodes failing join 18/24 in last 15m; keystore-decrypt-errors=high; region=eu-central-1

sam: can we do a targeted allow rule to KMS endpoint CIDR while rollback happens? prefer minimal blast radius.

priya: agree. which ip ranges? use aws describe-vpc-endpoints to get addresses. alex, can you grab endpoint ENID-KEYSERV?

alex: grabbed: vpce-0a1b2c3d -> interface ENIs in subnets 10.11.198.0/24 and 10.11.199.0/24. proposing temporary egress allow to those CIDRs on port 443 from warm-pool subnets.

morgan: doing that now. patch applied to prod-eu-central-fw: allow eg 10.11.198.0/24,10.11.199.0/24 -> 443 for tag role=warm-pool.

deploy-bot: Change c-20250610-fw-temp-allow started by morgan  patch applied to security-group sg-0f3b9 (eu-central-prod).

infrabot: METRIC: keystore_decrypt_errors dropped 60% within 90s of sg change. join success rate improved.

alex: partial recovery: 14/24 warm nodes joined successfully. still seeing 10 nodes with decrypt timeouts from AZ-b (same AZ as endpoint ENI?).

nina: investigating route tables for that AZ. possible drift: ENI for vpce-0a1b2c3d got scheduled on different subnet in AZ-b and we didn't include it in exception. I'll add the extra subnet 10.11.200.0/24 to the allowlist.

sam: is this a config drift problem in our IaC pipeline or a one-off manual correction? need to know root cause so we don't repeat.

nina: preliminary: the VPC endpoint interface IPs are dynamically allocated. IaC had the endpoint name but our firewall rule used static subnet list and missed the new ENI allocation.

priya: action items now: 1) keep temporary allowlist for all ENI subnets for the endpoint 2) rollback the restrictive rule once we have stable join 3) create a longer-term solution (eg: use security-group referencing for vpce or use endpoint policy-based allow).

morgan: done - added 10.11.200.0/24 allow. monitoring shows remaining nodes recovering. join complete in 7m.

alex: cost/ops note: because the warm-pool missed joins we had to expand us-east warm capacity by +4 nodes for customer SLAs, incremental cost estimated +$11.20/hr until eu fully recovered. tagging cost to incident-infra.

sam: long-term: proposal to stop using subnet IP lists for egress exceptions. options: - reference the VPC endpoint security-group (preferred) - central egress proxy next to endpoint - HA endpoints per AZ + automation to update fw.

nina: security agrees on sg-reference approach. I'll file a PR to switch fw allowlist to target the vpce ENI security-group and add CI check to fail PRs that tighten egress without endpoint coverage.

priya: please also add an alert for high decrypt-deadline errors tied to join failures so oncall gets faster signal.

infrabot: TASK CREATED: INF-2025-778 add decrypt-error alert and change fw allowlist to sg-ref. created by alex.

morgan: follow-up: I'll run a postmortem doc and include timeline, cost, and recommended IaC changes. linking once ready.

alex: thanks all. leaving thread open 4h for verification; will close after no regressions. :thumbsup:
